title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
description: This theatrical concert combines actors, singers, and orchestra to portray composer Maurice Ravel, along with his contemporaries Claude Debussy and George Gershwin. Created by Alice Wiley Pickett, it draws on Ravel's own writings and the words of his friends and critics, set to his music. It takes place Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
